title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1973-07-31
source: source: aud cassette master; taped by Jerry Moore; mastered: AKG 1000e > Sony TC-110 TDK c-120sd’s (re-shelled for transfer); Nakamichi Dragon > Benchmark ADC1 24/96 > Tascam HD-P2, compact flash > Mac > Adobe Audition CC > Flac; transferred and seeded by Rob Berger

ai_review.summary: Clear‑enough audience tape that captures the hot energy of the show, with a standout “I Know You Rider”.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience capture by Jerry Moore – clear enough to hear the band but marked by noticeable crowd noise. The performance is praised for its great energy and a particularly excellent rendition of “I Know You Rider”, making it a hot show despite the lack of a Sugaree.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed review rates the show 4 stars, noting strong musical performance and acceptable (though noisy) audience recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear sounding overall but with a prominent noisy crowd presence typical of audience tapes; captures the moment well despite ambient noise.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High energy throughout, described as a hot show; reviewers note strong overall momentum even though Sugaree is missing from the set.
